methodology.not_a_gate: This lab is diagnostic only. It does not kill, promote, or reweight edges.
methodology.pairwise_test: Same circular-shift permutation test as the single-threshold lab (see asset_independence_lab module docstring), run independently at each quantile level with its own Benjamini-Hochberg FDR correction across pairs.
methodology.probability_space: live_calibrated_probability (raw_probability through the single final live sigmoid calibrator), NOT calibrated_probability (a CPCV-fold-averaged research diagnostic that does not track raw_probability faithfully) -- see D015. This is the same column live scoring and the portfolio_allocator threshold grid use.
methodology.quantile_levels: Per-edge population quantiles, not fixed probability values, so edges with different raw probability scales stay comparable at each sweep level (e.g. 0.90 always means 'this edge's own top 10% most confident rows').
methodology.robustness_label: robustly_dependent = dependence detected (q<alpha, either test) at every level tested. robustly_independent = dependence detected at no level. threshold_sensitive = dependence detected at some but not all levels -- the verdict for this pair depends on where the allocator ends up setting its threshold.
methodology.why_a_sweep: A single per-edge selected_threshold is a sparse, non-authoritative diagnostic point (see config/mldp_deviation_register.json D015 and the edge-default threshold's own threshold_role note) -- the real live threshold is decided later by the portfolio_allocator. Testing independence at every plausible operating point instead of one arbitrary cutoff answers whether the independence verdict is robust to that not-yet-made decision, and uses far more data at every level than the sparse single-threshold approach.
